title: The closed strict-local fibre agrees over X with the vanishing-cycle fibre
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], $s:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to S$ a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point], and $S'=S_{(s)}$ its strict henselization [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit]. Let $(p:X'\to X,f':X'\to S')$ exhibit $X'=X\times_SS'$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Let $x':\operatorname{Spec}\Xi\to X'$ and $a:\operatorname{Spec}\Xi\to\operatorname{Spec}\Omega$ satisfy $f'\circ x'=\widetilde s\circ a$, where $\widetilde s$ is the canonical lift of $s$ [lem-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-functoriality]. For any geometric $t:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega'\to S'$, write $x=p\circ x'$, and let $\rho_{x'}$ and $\rho_x$ denote the structural strict-local maps. There exist isomorphisms $e:S'\simeq S_{(f\circ x)}$ and $E:X'_{(x')}\times_{S'}\operatorname{Spec}\Omega'\simeq V_{f,x,e\circ t}$ [def-weil-pbc-local-acyclicity-abelian-sheaf] such that $E$ followed by $V_{f,x,e\circ t}\to X_{(x)}\xrightarrow{\rho_x}X$ equals the projection to $X'_{(x')}$ followed by $p\circ\rho_{x'}$. No local acyclicity, properness, or torsion condition is assumed. Moreover the canonical pointed map $q:X'_{(x')}\to X_{(px')}$ is invertible, and $E$ commutes with the first projections followed by $q$.

proof.text: Apply strictBaseClosedPointLocalizations to these three pointed maps. Take its isomorphism e and its final fibre isomorphism E. Compose its first projection identity with the structural map to X, and use the structural identity for the strict-local map induced by p. Retain the invertibility of q and the first-projection equation supplied by that same localization theorem.

theorem localAcyclicity_strict_fibre_comparison
    {X S X' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ S)
    (p : X' ⟶ X) (f' : X' ⟶ Scheme.strictHenselizationScheme s)
    (hcart : IsPullback p f' f (Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap s))
    {Ξ : Type u} [Field Ξ] [IsAlgClosed Ξ] (x' : Spec (.of Ξ) ⟶ X')
    (a : Spec (.of Ξ) ⟶ Spec (.of Ω))
    (hclosed : x' ≫ f' =
      a ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Scheme.strictHenselizationPointEvaluation s)))
    {Ω' : Type u} [Field Ω'] [IsAlgClosed Ω']
    (t : Spec (.of Ω') ⟶ Scheme.strictHenselizationScheme s) :
    IsIso (localAcyclicityStrictMap p x') ∧
    ∃ e : Scheme.strictHenselizationScheme s ≅
        Scheme.strictHenselizationScheme ((x' ≫ p) ≫ f),
      ∃ E : pullback (Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap x' ≫ f') t ≅
          localAcyclicityFiber f (x' ≫ p) (t ≫ e.hom),
        E.hom ≫ pullback.fst (localAcyclicityStrictMap f (x' ≫ p)) (t ≫ e.hom) =
          pullback.fst (Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap x' ≫ f') t ≫
            localAcyclicityStrictMap p x' ∧
        E.hom ≫ pullback.fst (localAcyclicityStrictMap f (x' ≫ p)) (t ≫ e.hom) ≫
            Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap (x' ≫ p) =
          pullback.fst (Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap x' ≫ f') t ≫
            Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap x' ≫ p
